up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL274 (C-C chemokine receptor type 5). Return exactly these columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Apply filters for standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Order results by molecule_chembl_id ASC, then assay_chembl_id ASC. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type AS target_type,
  td.tax_id AS tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  ac.standard_type AS standard_type,
  ac.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value
FROM target_dictionary td
JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid
JOIN activities ac ON a.assay_id = ac.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ac.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON ac.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL274'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND ac.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND ac.standard_relation = '='
  AND ac.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  molecule_chembl_id ASC,
  assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
